defect.summary: Qualification-frame exclusion compared the complete received AX.25 body byte-for-byte against locally generated bodies. Legitimate RF address C/H-bit differences caused semantically identical P8 qualification frames to miss the exclusion filter and be counted as fresh non-qualification RX.
defect.observed_cycle2: Received P8 1/3 was reported fresh_non_p8=1 before the later real KJ6YWD>JIM packet.
defect.observed_cycle3: Received P8 2/3 was reported fresh_non_p8=1 and cycle 3 dispatched without a separately decoded non-P8 frame in the harness log.
defect.observed_final: Received P8 3/3 satisfied the final queue-empty RX proof before the later operator non-P8 transmission.
defect.root_cause: Raw-body equality is not a valid semantic self-echo classifier for AX.25 because C/H flag state may differ over RF while source, destination, path, frame type, PID and information payload remain the same.
defect.required_repair: Use semantic AX.25 parsing and compare callsign/SSID values while ignoring address flag bits; require UI, PID F0, locked path and locked qualification information payload. Add mutated-C/H-bit regression coverage.
